mapper.select: select * from library where library_name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')

select * from library join building on library_building = building_id join campus on building_campus = campus_id join university on campus_university = un_id join village on village_id = un_village join street on village_street = street_id join district on street_district = district_id join city on district_city = city_id join province on city_province = province_id
